exposure_finding.corrects_prior_claim: 前一版报告称『令牌值未被记录、仅命中扫描器临时脚本』，实测不成立
exposure_finding.method: sha256(value) 逐命中比对活 token，只输出布尔，不打印值
exposure_finding.severity_note: compaction 段会被反复注入上下文，等于每次读取都重放密钥；风险高于『子代理终端一次性输出』

why_owner_must_do_it.gh_cli: absent on host (no gh.exe, no hosts.yml) -> `gh auth logout` path unavailable
why_owner_must_do_it.oauth_revoke_api: DELETE /applications/{client_id}/token requires the OAuth App client_secret, which is not held locally
why_owner_must_do_it.by_design: a stolen credential must not be able to revoke/extend itself

residual_risk_accepted_by_owner: 该 token 仍然有效，scope 含 repo（对 zwdjwsam-creator/sam 有读写删权限）
任何已获得该 token 的外部方，在轮换前仍可操作仓库
本机历史备份/快照/云同步目录未全量复扫，可能存在未发现的明文副本
reversibility: 随时可改判；撤销只需 owner 在 https://github.com/settings/applications 点 Revoke access 后重写 token 文件第 5 行
recommended_but_not_executed: 缩小 scope 到仅该仓库（fine-grained PAT）
将 token 文件移出会被 agent 递归扫描的目录，或改为运行时注入
add a pre-commit/pre-upload guard that blocks any file containing gh[opsu]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
